lots.what_it_is: Three boxes of mixed homewares whose only item of interest is a Draminski Mastitis Detector (Polish handheld milk conductivity meter for detecting subclinical mastitis in dairy cows) in a blue hard case with yellow handle. Rest: small Chinese-style pierced porcelain ball lamp with famille-rose style enamel on a black bent arm, aluminium cone lamp base, white funnel lamp, glass bowling-pin bottle with aluminium ball stopper, plain cast iron teapot, hammered animal-print bowl, brownie and cake tins, Wanderer folding camp table, new kookaburra bamboo cheese board and knife, William Morris Strawberry Thief style tin, navy padded case with orange trim.
lots.score_reason: Identification of the Draminski is certain from the label, but model, completeness and working order are unknown and there is no used or sold price anywhere. New single-cup units retail about A$470 to A$575 before freight, so a used, untested unit of unknown model is plausibly worth A$100 to A$250 to a dairy farmer, with a real chance it is dead or missing parts. The rest of the lot is worth A$20 to A$80 at Tasmanian auction.
